standard.summary: EasyControl v2 是两路 DiT 条件控制路线，Colorization（上色）作为其中一种控制任务。当前 Lulynx 已把完整链路接成默认关的 opt-in 技术储备：契约 + 两路 patch + 训练步消费 + cond-latent 缓存生产者 + cache-first 数据集消费，真机已验证。推理侧上色渲染路径也已接（anima_colorize_inference.py）：载训练好的 adapter、把控制图编码成训练同款 cond latent、条件化每次 DiT forward（无控制图时逐位 parity，gate 强制关时回归 control-OFF）。condition warmup（跳过高噪声早期步、比例 0.6 默认）修掉早期轨迹破坏，真机已渲出彩色图（机制+关时 parity+真彩色图已交付，配色美学仍是用户的活）。
standard.effect: v2 通过条件 latent/text sidecar、cond token 和 per-block gate/LoRA delta 影响目标 token；上色任务用线稿/灰度控制图编码出的条件 latent 引导出图配色。
standard.whenToUse: 需要原生图像控制、上色或条件图像适配器时（默认关，需显式开启 + 操作员签字）。
standard.avoidWhen: 只想要零风险默认训练时；该路线默认关、不改变默认行为。

standard_en.summary: EasyControl v2 is a two-path DiT conditioning route, with colorization as one of its control tasks. In Lulynx the whole chain is wired as an off-by-default opt-in capability: the contract, the two patch paths, consumption in the training step, the cond-latent cache producer, and cache-first dataset consumption, all verified on real hardware. The inference-side colorization render path is wired too (anima_colorize_inference.py): it loads the trained adapter, encodes the control image into the same cond latent used in training, and conditions every DiT forward (bit-exact parity when there is no control image, and a return to control-OFF when the gate forces it off). Condition warmup (skipping the early high-noise steps, ratio 0.6 by default) fixed the early-trajectory damage, and colour images have been rendered on real hardware (the mechanism, off-state parity and real colour output are delivered; the aesthetics of the palette remain the user's work).
standard_en.effect: v2 influences the target tokens through a conditioning latent / text sidecar, cond tokens, and per-block gates and LoRA deltas; the colorization task guides the output's colours from a conditioning latent encoded out of a line-art or greyscale control image.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you need native image control, colorization, or a conditioning image adapter (off by default, requiring both an explicit opt-in and an operator sign-off).
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you want risk-free default training -- the route is off by default and changes no default behaviour.

advanced.principle: 目标 token 的 query 可以 attend 到 target+condition keys，并通过条件列 bias 控制强度。
advanced.intervention: colorize_preprocess 产线稿/灰度控制图 → colorize_cond_cache 用真 Qwen-Image VAE 把控制图编码成 cond-latent sidecar → AnimaCachedDataset 加载 sidecar → 训练步把 condition 喂给两路 patch → adapter 随 LoRA 存（easycontrol_v2.* 前缀）。
advanced.expectedImpact: 默认关时不改变训练性能（bitwise parity）；开启后增加少量条件 token 和 LoRA/gate 计算，并让出图按控制图配色。
advanced.tradeoffs: v1 easy_control_enabled 仍是独立低风险 fallback，v2 不应静默替换 v1。无控制图的样本回退到 cache-first 派生参考（仅机制可用，非控制质量）。

advanced_en.principle: Target tokens' queries can attend to target+condition keys, with strength controlled by a condition-column bias.
advanced_en.intervention: colorize_preprocess produces line-art/grayscale control images → colorize_cond_cache encodes them into cond-latent sidecars with the real Qwen-Image VAE → AnimaCachedDataset loads the sidecar → the training step feeds the condition to both patch routes → the adapter is saved with the LoRA (easycontrol_v2.* prefix).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Off by default, no change to training performance (bitwise parity); when on, adds a few condition tokens and LoRA/gate compute and makes output follow the control image's colors.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: v1 easy_control_enabled remains a separate low-risk fallback; v2 must not silently replace v1. Samples without control images fall back to cache-first derived reference (mechanism availability only, not control quality).
